title: Cobra
steps: Lie face down with your legs long behind you.
Place your hands beside your chest with your elbows close to your body.
Press lightly into your hands and lift your chest a small amount.
Keep your shoulders down and hold for a couple of breaths.
Lower slowly and rest your cheek on the mat.
mistakes: Pressing up so far that the lower back feels pinched.
Shrugging the shoulders toward the ears.
